name: Incident Review
tagline: A sober technical postmortem with severity cover, impact, detection log, timeline, causal chain, recovery evidence and owned actions.

palette.description: Operational navy and cool paper with amber severity markers and restrained red cause emphasis.

typography.style: Clear sans-serif incident headlines and monospaced timestamps, status and technical evidence.

best_for: Blameless incident reviews needing timeline, impact scope, root cause, response, recovery verification and action owners.
avoid_for: Marketing testimonials, unverified production claims, or visually playful launch decks.
